title: GET /api/v1/feed success
description: Entries from every machine of the account, and its prompts still waiting for answers (`open`). With `after`: those with a greater seq, in increasing seq. Otherwise (`before`, or neither for the newest): those with a smaller seq, in decreasing seq. `more` says whether further entries exist in that direction. `latest_seq` is the account's greatest seq, 0 for an empty feed.

open.description: The account's prompts still waiting for their answers, newest first: the whole list on every read, not only what changed after `after`. A prompt drops out when the entry that answers it arrives (that entry's `prompt` has the same `id`).
